title: Hero → first content section gap is 45px looser than live (17 pages) — found via CORE-7130
body:
Surfaced by the CORE-7130 sweep, unrelated to that ticket and in the **opposite direction**. Not yet
filed in Linear — needs a ticket.

**17 pages.** Hero (`PageTitle`) -> first content section:

- clone gap is **+45px looser** (+40px at 360)
- clone hero box is **22px shorter** (2px at 768, 40.7px at 360)

Cause: the clone moves the hero's bottom spacing from *inside* the section to a *margin below* it.
Net downward drift approx **+23px desktop, +43px at 768, ~0 at 360**.

It reads as correct on casual inspection because the shift is uniform — every downstream gap still
measures right, so it never presents as a gap defect. That is also why no existing ticket has caught it.

Needs its own investigation before any fix: confirm the 17 pages, decide whether the spacing belongs
inside the hero section (matching live) or below it, and check whether the hero height difference is the
same root cause or a second defect.
acceptanceCriteria: Linear ticket raised for the hero → first-content-section drift.
Decision on whether hero bottom spacing moves back inside the section.
Hero height difference (22px desktop / 40.7px at 360) resolved or split into its own ticket.
